name: UAT-cycle
description: Execute a UAT test case — select, test, process findings, fix or log, and close the cycle.

name: architecture-check
description: Validate module boundaries, check for architectural drift, and suggest fitness function tests. Compares actual code structure against ARCHITECTURE.md.

name: backlog-review
description: Execute comprehensive backlog review. Analyzes theme coverage, story quality, dependencies, and generates a backlog health report.

name: claude-sense-check
description: Incremental code logic verification of UAT test cases — pick batch, trace code, fix issues, update tracking.

name: bootstrap
description: First-run framework setup. Detects existing project stack or guides new project creation from vision/braindump.

name: brainstorm
description: Use when the user has a complex idea that needs design exploration before story decomposition.

name: code-quality
description: Analyzes code quality, complexity, duplication, and architectural patterns. Use after implementing features, during code review, or when preparing for PR. Auto-invoke when user has completed significant code changes or asks to review code quality.

name: commit
description: Create a well-formatted conventional commit with proper message structure. Use when ready to commit changes.

name: continue
description: Resume development with smart session continuation. Reads session handoff files, analyzes git state, and determines the best path forward.

name: custom-hooks
description: Create project-specific hook scripts and register them in settings.json. Extends the framework's enforcement layer.

name: dashboard
description: Sprint status overview with session insights, sprint trends, and actionable next steps.

name: discover
description: Deep guided elicitation for new projects. Archetype-aware, research-backed, multi-phase discovery with assumption tracking and Phase Transition Stories.

name: debug-session
description: Use when the user reports a bug, error, or unexpected behavior that needs investigation.

name: doctor
description: Validate framework configuration, check runtime dependencies, and report issues. Use when something isn't working or after setup.

name: fix-issue
description: Fix a GitHub issue following project coding standards. Creates branch, implements fix with TDD, and prepares PR.

name: framework-upgrade
description: Upgrade Exosuit to a newer version while preserving project customizations.

name: handoff
description: Generate a structured handoff document for ending a development session. Saves to docs/sessions/ for the continue skill to read.

name: help-me
description: Natural language skill discovery — describe what you want to do and get matched to the right skill.

name: ideate
description: Use when the user has an idea or requirement to decompose into backlog stories.

name: live-test
description: Use when the user wants a scope (feature area, story ID, route, command, or recent changes) tested automatically against the running application — the automated sibling of /manual-test.

name: manual-test
description: Prepare for manual testing session with test plan based on known issues, recent changes, and acceptance criteria.

name: optimize
description: Use when the user wants to autonomously improve a measurable metric through iterative experimentation with git-based checkpointing and automatic rollback.

name: parallel-work
description: Manage git worktrees for parallel Claude Code instances working on different stories. List, create, and clean up worktrees.

name: phase-review
description: Phase transition review — walkthrough, assumption validation, research refresh, pivot-or-persevere decision, and next-phase planning.

name: performance-check
description: Analyze performance patterns — N+1 queries, unbounded operations, blocking I/O, memory leaks, and scaling behavior. Auto-invoke after performance-sensitive code changes.

name: pr-status
description: Check status of open pull requests and provide options for next steps. Use to review PR status, handle feedback, or merge approved PRs.

name: quickstart
description: Guided interactive tour of the framework — walks through your first sprint from zero to shipped PR.

name: refine-loop
description: Use when the user wants iterative self-improvement on a deliverable (document, implementation, prompt, design) until completion criteria are met.

name: research
description: Deep online research on any topic. Produces structured reports with citations and confidence scores. Three depth modes — quick scan, standard investigation, or deep dive.

name: retrospective
description: Run a sprint or weekly retrospective using the 4Ls framework with metrics dashboard. Analyzes what worked, what was learned, what was lacking, and what we wish we had.

name: security-audit
description: Security review for code touching authentication, credentials, file access, or user data. Includes CWE checklist and phantom package detection. MANDATORY for auth code, credential handling, file operations with user data, network comms, or database queries with user input.

name: skill-create
description: Analyze the repository's technology stack and generate appropriate skills, rules, and hook configurations.

name: skill-eval
description: Use when you want to test, measure, or compare skill effectiveness. Supports eval (test against scenario), compare (A/B test two versions), and metrics (track execution data).

name: sprint-end
description: Use when the user wants to ship a sprint's work to main via PR.

name: sprint-start
description: Pre-sprint checks and feature branch creation. Ensures clean state before starting work. Supports git worktrees for parallel development.

name: story-cycle
description: Use when the user wants to implement a single story or deliver a backlog item.

name: test-validator
description: Validates test coverage, quality, and TDD compliance. Detects weakened assertions, deleted tests, and tautological patterns. Auto-invoke when user has written code and needs test validation.

name: testing-cycle
description: Process a single user testing feedback item — classify, fix or log, verify, and report.

name: uninstall
description: Cleanly remove the Exosuit framework from a project while preserving project-specific content.

name: undo-work
description: Safely discard or revert failed implementation attempts and restore a clean working state.

name: build
description: Build a project from a plain-English description. Handles all technical decisions automatically. Designed for non-technical users but useful for anyone who wants fast results.

name: deploy
description: Deploy the project to a hosting platform. Detects deployment configuration, runs pre-deploy checks, and guides first-time setup.

name: quality-check
description: Unified quality gate dispatcher. Runs selected quality checks with profile-aware defaults.

name: weekly-maintenance
description: Execute comprehensive weekly maintenance routine (1-2 hours, Friday recommended). Includes health checks, quality review, dependency governance, activity insights, and planning.
